subject_line: avoid using an extra t variable leaking into parent function's scope
s1_reason: removes implicit global `t` write in the :has() compiler branch; published diff 2.2.26->2.2.27 is exactly this hunk plus e.parentElement null guards
s2_reason: the :has(+ S) branch calls s.select("*+S", e.parentElement) with a new context per element, which misses the resolver cache and recompiles per element, so compiler cost scales with element count
s3_reason: <pseudo_class_function> "has" <relative_selector_list> with <relative_combinator> "+"/"~"/">"; compiled resolver runs inside nw.select() in the timed loop
confounds: same release adds e.parentElement null guard for :has(+/~) at root (#169 fix shipped here per tarball diff), a correctness change: 2.2.26 throws where 2.2.27 does not
notes: CORRECTNESS: null-guard changes behaviour at <html>; measured in nwsapi_known as 2.2.26 vs 2.2.27. Runner comment attributes #171 270x slowdown to 2.2.26; the 2.2.26->2.2.27 tarball diff is only this :has hunk, so #171 is NOT obviously fixed here (unverified)

subject_line: attempted improvements by restoring bounded ES5 resolver cache
s1_reason: replaces Map-based LRU with ES5 object+linked-list LRU for lambdas/resolvers
s2_reason: cache get/set happens per element when compiled resolvers call s.match (:not) / s.select, s.first, s.has (:has) with per-element contexts; otherwise one lookup per call
s3_reason: :not(<complex_selector_list>) and :has(<relative_selector_list>) produce per-element nested lookups; resolver execution is inside the timed nw.select() loop
confounds: 2.2.25->2.2.26 also has 24cdab6 (focus/display-state pseudo-classes via native detection; omitted constructs) and faa8468 (has() root fix); tarball 2.2.26 does not byte-match any git commit
notes: Release with #171 (270x slowdown) and #172 (stack overflow) per subject example.py; which commit causes it is unattributed. Measured in nwsapi_known as 2.2.25 vs 2.2.26

s3_reason: :not(...) and :has(...) in grammar; lookups inside timed nw.select()
confounds: 2.2.24->2.2.25 also has 7a22775 (revised :has compiler), c98779b/25aa3ea (display-state pseudo-classes, omitted), c3c44f8 (popover, omitted)
